title: Validation-only research claim review
scope: Interpretation correctness and claim boundaries; not full experiment completion, novelty certification, significance testing, or cost validation
method: Read INTERPRETATION.md and frozen SCIENCE_SPEC; independently recomputed three-seed receipt means, sample SDs, ratios and worsening seed sets from all 27 Validation receipts using Python standard library; checked additional claims against original receipt values. Separate prediction-level arithmetic QA is recorded in INDEPENDENT_QA.json.
recommendation_summary: Keep B as a research candidate and defer designation as the core method. Taxi large-quantity improvement is supported; broad superiority over the ordinary MLP is not. Await matched cost verification without implying that cost gains or novelty have already been established.
tradeoffs: B retains a documented Taxi large-quantity benefit while worsening other dataset/metric/seed combinations.
The single MLP is a materially simpler alternative and has lower mean overall quantity RMSE on all three datasets, but is not automatically a novel contribution or superior on every target.
risks: Validation selected checkpoints and was reused for structure comparison.
Only three seeds and three datasets; seed and GPU effects are not separable in this allocation.
Matching total correction parameters does not match active-prefix capacity or function class.
No distribution-parameter re-evaluation was performed for recorded TimeNLL.
validation_steps: Independent receipt aggregation and arithmetic cross-check.
Read full interpretation for distinction between factual results, exploratory hypotheses, and recommendations.
Confirm no Test, cost-result, remote, new inference, or training work was used in this review.
limitations: cuDNN numeric environment versions were not independently re-audited in this claim-review pass; the experimental source/provenance QA remains the basis for those environment facts.
This pass does not certify statistical significance, equivalence, publication suitability, literature novelty, or cost-measurement completion.
